faq.q: Where and what is OmShakthy Elite Grand?
faq.a: OmShakthy Elite Grand is a residential plot development located near Guduvanchery, one of Chennai's fastest-growing residential corridors, within the new CMA limits of Chennai. Spread across 7.03 acres, it offers 177 DTCP-approved plots ranging from 640 Sq.ft to 2773 Sq.ft.

faq.q: Has OmShakthy Elite Grand CMDA/DTCP Approved?
faq.a: Yes, OmShakthy Elite Grand is DTCP-approved. The project falls within the new CMA (Chennai Metropolitan Area) limits, giving buyers added confidence in a legally compliant and well-planned residential layout.

faq.q: What is the price range for residential plots at OmShakthy Elite Grand?
faq.a: Plots at OmShakthy Elite Grand start from ₹10L onwards, with 177 plots ranging in size from 640 Sq.ft to 2773 Sq.ft across 7.03 acres.

faq.q: What are the amenities provided with residential plots at OmShakthy Elite Grand?
faq.a: OmShakthy Elite Grand features a grand entrance archway, developed landscaped areas, and abundant potable water, and is part of a larger 110-acre integrated township. The project also offers excellent connectivity via rail and road, with proximity to GST Road and nearby IT corridors and industrial hubs.
